flavours.name: Mountain Dew
flavours.notes: A citrus-flavored soda developed in the 1940s by Barney and Ally Hartman, beverage bottlers in Tennessee.
flavours.update: Original citrus soda; Zero Sugar since 2020

flavours.name: Diet Mountain Dew
flavours.notes: A low-calorie variant first introduced in 1988, replacing the similar drink "Sugar Free Mountain Dew".

flavours.name: Diet Caffeine-Free Mountain Dew
flavours.notes: A variant without sugar or caffeine, available in parts of the United States.

flavours.name: Code Red
flavours.notes: A cherry variant introduced in 2001 and the first widely successful flavor extension.

flavours.name: LiveWire
flavours.notes: An orange variant introduced in 2003 as a limited-edition flavor for the summer.

flavours.name: Baja Blast
flavours.notes: A tropical lime variant introduced in 2004 exclusively as a fountain drink at Taco Bell restaurants.
flavours.availability: Wide retail and Taco Bell (US); Taco Bell (UK, from June 2026)
flavours.update: Tropical lime; year-round in stores since 2024

flavours.name: Voltage
flavours.notes: A blue raspberry/citrus variant with ginseng.

flavours.name: Real Sugar
flavours.notes: A variant containing natural sugar in place of high-fructose corn syrup released during mid-2009 under the name Mountain Dew Throwback.
flavours.update: Cane-sugar original; mostly glass bottles now

flavours.name: Goji Citrus Strawberry
flavours.notes: A goji/strawberry/citrus variant released in 2017 exclusively at select convenience stores and college campuses.

flavours.name: Voo-Dew
flavours.notes: An annually released mystery-flavored Mountain Dew released for the Halloween season.

flavours.name: Baja Cabo Citrus
flavours.notes: Tropical punch flavored Dew, part of the Baja Blast line.
flavours.update: Tropical citrus punch; permanent from Jan 2026; 2L due Jan 2027

flavours.name: Trolli (Cherry-Lemon)
flavours.notes: "Cherry-lemon" flavored Dew, part of a collaboration with Trolli candy.
flavours.update: 2025 limited run; replaced by Mango Pineapple Punch

flavours.name: Trolli (Mango Pineapple Punch)
flavours.notes: Mango pineapple punch flavored Dew, also part of a collaboration with Trolli candy.
flavours.availability: US retail and Pizza Hut, through October 2026
flavours.update: Mango, pineapple, hint of strawberry; runs through October 2026

flavours.name: Dirty Mountain Dew
flavours.notes: A dirty soda-inspired flavor that blends Mountain Dew and cream soda.

flavours.name: Berry Monsoon
flavours.notes: A berry lime variant exclusive to Sam's Club locations in May 2018 in the United States.

flavours.name: Sweet Lightning
flavours.notes: A peach variant exclusive to KFC restaurants from late March 2019.

flavours.name: Maui Burst
flavours.notes: A pineapple variant exclusive to Dollar General.

flavours.name: Frost Bite
flavours.notes: A honeydew/melon variant exclusive to Walmart stores, released in March 2020 as a permanent flavor.

flavours.name: Dragon Fruit
flavours.notes: A dragon fruit variant exclusive to Walmart stores, released on June 16, 2025 as a permanent flavor.

flavours.name: Atomic Blue
flavours.notes: An "electrifying lemonade" variant exclusive to select Sheetz and Kum & Go fountains released in May 2020.

flavours.name: Southern Shock
flavours.notes: A fruit punch variant exclusive to Bojangles.

flavours.name: Vibe
flavours.notes: A lemon variant exclusive to Which Wich restaurants.

flavours.name: Thrashed Apple
flavours.notes: A crisp apple variant exclusive to Kroger-owned stores released in September 2021.

flavours.name: Uproar
flavours.notes: A strawberry-kiwi variant exclusive to Food Lion.

flavours.name: Dark Berry Bash
flavours.notes: A blue raspberry and blackberry variant exclusive to Applebee's restaurants and their Cosmic Wings virtual brand.

flavours.name: Legend
flavours.notes: A blackberry lime variant exclusive to Buffalo Wild Wings.

flavours.name: Purple Thunder
flavours.notes: A blackberry and plum variant exclusive to Circle K, Kroger, and Couche Tard.
flavours.update: Blackberry plum; bottles and cans ended early 2026, fountain only

flavours.name: Overdrive
flavours.notes: A citrus punch variant with "hints of mango, raspberry and lime flavors."

flavours.name: Infinite Swirl
flavours.notes: A pineapple strawberry flavor exclusive to 7-Eleven owned convenience stores.
flavours.update: Pineapple strawberry; reported to leave shelves after Dec 2025

flavours.name: Pitch Black
flavours.notes: A dark citrus punch variant first released in fall 2004, originally described as 'dark grape'.
flavours.update: Dark citrus punch; permanent in Malaysia; dropped in Canada 2025

flavours.name: Baja Midnight
flavours.notes: A passionfruit flavor, exclusive to Taco Bell restaurants.

flavours.name: Mango Rush
flavours.notes: Dew with a blast of natural and artificial Mango Sweet Heat flavor
flavours.update: Mango sweet heat; returning limited run

flavours.name: Kickstart Orange Citrus
flavours.notes: An orange variant released on February 25, 2013, advertised to have caffeine and electrolytes to provide energy for the morning.

flavours.name: Kickstart Fruit Punch
flavours.notes: A fruit punch variant released on February 25, 2013, advertised to have caffeine, B vitamins, and electrolytes to provide energy for the morning.

flavours.name: Kickstart Black Cherry
flavours.notes: A black cherry variant released in January 2014, advertised to contain caffeine and electrolytes to provide energy for the evening.

flavours.name: Kickstart Limeade
flavours.notes: A limeade variant released alongside Black Cherry.

flavours.name: Kickstart Pineapple Orange Mango
flavours.notes: A pineapple/orange/mango variant that contains Coconut Water.

flavours.name: Kickstart Blood Orange
flavours.notes: A blood orange variant released in early 2016 that contains the antioxidants vitamins C and E.

flavours.name: Kickstart Hydrating Watermelon
flavours.notes: A watermelon variant that contains coconut water.

flavours.name: Kickstart Blueberry Pomegranate
flavours.notes: A blueberry/pomegranate variant released in early 2016 that contains antioxidants - vitamins C and E.

flavours.name: Kickstart Midnight Grape
flavours.notes: A grape variant released in 2016 that contains 5% juice.

flavours.name: Kickstart Raspberry Citrus
flavours.notes: A raspberry/citrus variant released in the first quarter of 2017 that contains coconut water.

flavours.name: Kickstart Mango Lime
flavours.notes: A mango/lime variant released in the first quarter of 2017 that contains 5% juice.

flavours.name: Kickstart Original
flavours.notes: A variant with the flavor of original Mountain Dew released in early 2018.

flavours.name: Kickstart Ultra
flavours.notes: A low-calorie version of Kickstart Original released in early 2018.

flavours.name: Kickstart Strawberry Start-Up
flavours.notes: Strawberry lemon Kickstart introduced in 2023.

flavours.name: Charged Cherry Burst
flavours.notes: A cherry variant, launched as 'Amp Game Fuel' in 2019.

flavours.name: Charged Berry Blast
flavours.notes: A berry variant, launched as 'Amp Game Fuel' in 2019.

flavours.name: Charged Original Dew
flavours.notes: A variant based on the original Mountain Dew, launched as 'Amp Game Fuel' in 2019.

flavours.name: Charged Tropical Strike
flavours.notes: A tropical variant, launched as 'Amp Game Fuel' in 2019.

flavours.name: Charged Orange Storm
flavours.notes: An orange variant launched as 'Amp Game Fuel' in 2019 with the launch of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare.

flavours.name: Zero Charged Watermelon Shock
flavours.notes: A zero-sugar watermelon variant that was phased out in late 2021.

flavours.name: Zero Charged Raspberry Lemonade
flavours.notes: A zero-sugar raspberry lemonade variant.

flavours.name: Courageous Sherbet
flavours.notes: A rainbow sherbet variant, also available in zero sugar.

flavours.name: Championship Citrus Cherry
flavours.notes: A re-release of original Citrus Cherry Game Fuel flavor.

flavours.name: Pomegranate Blue Burst
flavours.notes: A blueberry pomegranate low sugar energy drink with 180 mg of caffeine.

flavours.name: Strawberry Melon Spark
flavours.notes: A strawberry melon low sugar energy drink with 180 mg of caffeine.

flavours.name: Berry Blitz
flavours.notes: An acai berry low sugar energy drink with 180 mg of caffeine.

flavours.name: Tropical Sunrise
flavours.notes: A tropical pineapple low sugar energy drink with 180 mg of caffeine.

flavours.name: Peach Mango Dawn
flavours.notes: A peach-mango low sugar energy drink with 180 mg of caffeine.

flavours.name: Orange Breeze
flavours.notes: An orange low sugar energy drink with 180 mg of caffeine.

flavours.name: Cherry Lime Lift
flavours.notes: A low sugar cherry and lime flavored energy drink.

flavours.name: Baja Blast (Energy)
flavours.notes: Baja Blast flavored energy drink.

flavours.name: Code Red (Energy)
flavours.notes: Mountain Dew Code Red flavored energy drink.

flavours.name: Pitch Black (Energy)
flavours.notes: Limited-time release, based on Mountain Dew Pitch Black.

flavours.name: Major Melon (Energy)
flavours.notes: Limited-time release, based on Mountain Dew Major Melon.

flavours.name: Blue Shock Freeze
flavours.notes: A raspberry/citrus variant.

flavours.name: Electric Charge
flavours.notes: A sour lemon variant released in U.S. convenience stores, including Sheetz.

flavours.name: Game Fuel Berry Lime
flavours.notes: A berry/lime variant exclusively at 7-Eleven stores.

flavours.name: X-Treme
flavours.notes: A grape variant similar to "Pitch Black" released in Kuwait during December 2010 and later in Saudi Arabia.

flavours.name: Energy/Citrus Blast
flavours.notes: A new line of Mountain Dew released in the U.K. in June 2010, originally in 500ml bottles, but as of February 2011 it has expanded to 440ml cans (normal and sugar free) and 1 Litre bottles.
flavours.availability: Sold as Citrus Blast in the UK and Mountain Dew Energy in Ireland and Italy
flavours.update: UK's main grocery Dew, real sugar

flavours.name: Adrenaline Mountain Dew
flavours.notes: An energy variant that contains caffeine, taurine, guarana extract, ginseng, and vitamins B2 and B12.

flavours.name: Energised
flavours.notes: A caffeinated variant released in June 2012 in Australia, like Canada's relaunch a few months earlier.

flavours.name: Passionfruit Frenzy
flavours.notes: A passion fruit variant released in New Zealand on 15 October 2012.

flavours.name: Supernova (Finland/Denmark)
flavours.notes: A raspberry-lemon variant.

flavours.name: Electric Citrus
flavours.notes: A citrus variant released in Spain in 2015.

flavours.name: Energy Game Fuel
flavours.notes: A limited-edition raspberry/citrus flavor released in the United Kingdom to promote the release of Halo 4 in 2012 and the Xbox One in 2013.

flavours.name: AMP Energy — Powered by Mountain Dew (UK)
flavours.notes: A citrus-flavored energy drink variant released under the 'AMP' brand in the U.K. in August 2013 by PepsiCo.

flavours.name: Game Fuel (India)
flavours.notes: A green-colored variant of Mountain Dew Game Fuel launched in India on June 9, 2016.

flavours.name: Blue Shock
flavours.notes: A raspberry citrus variant released in 2014, as part of the DEWmocracy Malaysia promotion.
flavours.update: Raspberry citrus; limited in the Philippines

flavours.name: Major Melon
flavours.notes: A watermelon flavor released on January 4, 2021, as a permanent flavor in both regular and zero sugar varieties.
flavours.availability: Sold as Pink Drip in Honduras
flavours.update: Watermelon; ended in the US (2025) and Canada (2026), still sold in Honduras as Pink Drip

flavours.name: Summer Freeze
flavours.notes: A summer flavor inspired by the taste of a bomb pop, with cherry, raspberry and lemon flavors.
flavours.update: Cherry, lemon, raspberry; permanent in Canada from Apr 2026

flavours.name: Caffeine-Free Mountain Dew
flavours.notes: A caffeine-free variant of the original Mountain Dew flavor.

flavours.name: Red
flavours.notes: This flavor was described as tasting like fruit punch.

flavours.name: Sport
flavours.notes: A Mountain Dew-flavored sports drink that was released in a limited number of U.S. regions in 1990 following initial test marketing in 1989.

flavours.name: Pitch Black II
flavours.notes: A "sequel" flavor released for the 2005 Halloween season, it was different from the original Pitch Black, as it had a sour grape flavor.

flavours.name: Darth Dew
flavours.notes: A limited production tangy grape Slurpee flavor.

flavours.name: MDX
flavours.notes: A Mountain Dew-flavored energy soda introduced in 2005 in 14-US-fluid-ounce (410 ml) bottles.

flavours.name: Game Fuel Citrus Cherry
flavours.notes: A citrus-cherry variant introduced in August 2007 for 12 weeks to promote the release of Halo 3.

flavours.name: Revolution
flavours.notes: A wild berry-flavored Mountain Dew with ginseng.

flavours.name: Supernova
flavours.notes: A strawberry/melon flavor with ginseng.
flavours.update: Berry melon; made permanent in Canada Apr 2026; no cans

flavours.name: Game Fuel Alliance Blue
flavours.notes: A wild fruit punch flavor released alongside "Mountain Dew Game Fuel Horde Red" (Citrus Cherry Game Fuel) for a 10-week period in 2009.

flavours.name: Diet Mountain Dew Ultra Violet
flavours.notes: A mixed berry-flavored Mountain Dew originally available for three months in 2009, it was the first flavor available exclusively in Diet.

flavours.name: White Out
flavours.notes: A smooth citrus variant part of the "DEWmocracy: Collective Intelligence" promotion with a limited release starting on April 19, 2010.

flavours.name: Distortion
flavours.notes: A lime variant that was part of the second "DEWmocracy: Collective Intelligence" promotion.

flavours.name: Typhoon
flavours.notes: A strawberry/pineapple-flavored Mountain Dew.

flavours.name: Game Fuel Tropical
flavours.notes: A tropical variant released to coincide with the release of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3.

flavours.name: Dark Berry
flavours.notes: A limited-edition mixed berry variant with a release coinciding with the film The Dark Knight Rises.

flavours.name: Johnson City Gold
flavours.notes: A malt variant with lemon-lime named after Johnson City, Tennessee, that was test-marketed in August 2012 in the Chicago area, Denver, Colorado, and Charlotte, North Carolina.

flavours.name: Cold Fusion
flavours.notes: A cherry/lime Slurpee that was released in U.S. convenience stores, including Sheetz.

flavours.name: Game Fuel Electrifying Berry
flavours.notes: A berry variant was released to coincide with the release of the video game Ryse: Son of Rome for the Xbox One.

flavours.name: Sangrita Blast
flavours.notes: A cherry/pomegranate variant introduced in 2013 and available exclusively as a fountain drink at Taco Bell restaurants.

flavours.name: Game Fuel Lemonade
flavours.notes: A lemonade variant introduced on October 6, 2014, to promote Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare.

flavours.name: Dewitos
flavours.notes: A Doritos-flavored Mountain Dew taste-tested on U.S. college campuses.

flavours.name: Dewshine
flavours.notes: A clear, citrus variant made with real sugar and available in glass bottles.

flavours.name: Game Fuel Mango Heat
flavours.notes: A mango variant with a ginger finish.

flavours.name: Spiked Lemonade
flavours.notes: A lemonade variant "spiked with thirst-quenching prickly pear cactus juice" and created with "no artificial sweeteners" and "real fruit juice".

flavours.name: Spiked Raspberry Lemonade
flavours.notes: A raspberry lemonade Dew "spiked with thirst-quenching prickly pear cactus juice".

flavours.name: DEW-S-A
flavours.notes: A combination of Code Red, White Out, and Voltage released as a limited edition from May through August 2017.

flavours.name: Game Fuel Arctic Burst
flavours.notes: A Slurpee flavor available exclusively at 7-Eleven stores as part of a promotion for Superman Returns.

flavours.name: Game Fuel Tropical Smash
flavours.notes: A tropical variant released alongside Arctic Burst as a Game Fuel flavor, promoting the video game Forza Motorsport 7.

flavours.name: Holiday Brew
flavours.notes: A variant composed of original Mountain Dew and Code Red released in late 2017 alongside Pepsi Salted Caramel, Holiday Brew refers to the traditional Christmas colors of green and red.

flavours.name: Black Label
flavours.notes: A crafted dark berry variant released in 16 oz. cans in 2015.

flavours.name: White Label
flavours.notes: A pineapple/grapefruit variant described as "Mysteriously Exotic Dew", sold in 16 oz. cans similar to that of Black Label and Green Label.

flavours.name: Green Label
flavours.notes: A kiwi-apple variant described as "Curiously Daring Dew".

flavours.name: ICE
flavours.notes: A low-calorie clear lemon-lime flavored Mountain Dew released in 2018.

flavours.name: ICE Cherry
flavours.notes: A cherry variant of Mountain Dew ICE that was released in late 2018 as a limited-time flavor.

flavours.name: Merry Mash-Up
flavours.notes: A holiday-themed cranberry/pomegranate flavor.

flavours.name: Liberty Chill
flavours.notes: A fruit-flavored variant, known as Liberty Brew in 2019 and 2020.

flavours.name: Baja Punch
flavours.notes: A tropical punch dew flavor released in June 2021 to coincide with the Summer of Baja promotion.

flavours.name: Baja Flash
flavours.notes: A pina colada dew flavor released in June 2021 to coincide with the Summer of Baja promotion.

flavours.name: Cake-Smash
flavours.notes: A birthday cake-flavored Mountain Dew released exclusively on the Mountain Dew online store.

flavours.name: Flamin' Hot
flavours.notes: A spicy citrus flavor of Mountain Dew, advertised as "the first-ever beverage combining the sweet, citrus flavor of Dew with the spicy, kicked up flavor of Flamin' Hot for the most extreme taste experience yet."

flavours.name: Gingerbread Snap'd
flavours.notes: A gingerbread cookie-flavored Dew released for the 2021 holiday season.

flavours.name: Baja Gold
flavours.notes: Flavor in the Baja Blast line, described as "a bright island pineapple flavor"

flavours.name: Baja Mango Gem
flavours.notes: Flavor in the Baja Blast line, described as "a colorful orange tropical mango flavor"

flavours.name: Baja Deep Dive
flavours.notes: Mystery flavor in the Baja Blast line described as "taking the classic Baja flavor to new depths."

flavours.name: Fruit Quake
flavours.notes: A fruitcake flavor released for the 2022 holiday season.

flavours.name: Baja Caribbean Splash
flavours.notes: Flavor in the Baja Blast line, described as "Dew with a blast of natural and artificial guava flavor"

flavours.name: Baja Passionfruit Punch
flavours.notes: Flavor in the Baja Blast line, described as "Dew with a blast of natural and artificial passionfruit flavor"

flavours.name: HoneyDEW
flavours.notes: Honeydew melon flavor sold in Canada for a limited time in 2023.

flavours.name: Game Fuel Mystic Punch
flavours.notes: A fruit punch flavor with Diablo IV branding.

flavours.name: Baja Laguna Lemonade
flavours.notes: Mango lemonade flavored Dew.

flavours.name: Baja Point Break Punch
flavours.notes: Tropical punch flavored Dew.

flavours.name: Star Spangled Splash
flavours.notes: Berry flavored Dew.

flavours.name: Freedom Fusion
flavours.notes: A peach lemonade flavored Dew.

flavours.name: Game Fuel Citrus Blackberry
flavours.notes: A Blackberry–Raspberry flavored Dew with World of Warcraft: The War Within branding.

flavours.name: Spark
flavours.notes: A raspberry lemonade flavor originally offered exclusively at Speedway gas stations for a limited time during August 2020 and has since been released widely.

flavours.name: Citrus Blackberry
flavours.notes: A caffeinated citrus blackberry Dew, a soda version of the 2024 Game Fuel flavour.

flavours.name: Baja Leo
flavours.notes: A spicy take on Baja Blast, made for Baja Blast's birthday.
flavours.availability: One-day TikTok Shop drop on Aug 12, 2026

flavours.name: Ice (India)
flavours.notes: A lemon-juice-based Mountain Dew made for India. Not the same drink as the clear US ICE from 2018.
